scope: Operating attribution and prospective countercase for Intel earnings-to-cash candidate test. No forwardEPS or equity value calculated. Existing modelvalues known historically; new comparableEPS outputs not viewed.
verdict: Existing earnings premium, if the accounting bridge confirms it, rests mainly on stronger DCAI sales and rapid Foundry loss reduction. Packaging contributes little to the2027-2028earnings step. These are substantive prospective judgments, not a newly discovered customer order or observed cash result.

selected_operating_countercase_before_EP.reason: Use the previously source-led slower Foundry path to test whether the earnings disagreement survives delayed cost absorption, while granting the positive product-sales case.
